method: Unprompted English transcription from the decoded 16 kHz mono final MP3, independent segments, deterministic decoding; word alignment lowercases and removes punctuation. Interpret recognized differences by line. A recognition result cannot establish a human listener’s judgment.

lines.caption: The optic and the fiber must match the supplied profile. A pleasing glow is not a compatibility test.
lines.transcript: The optic and the fiber must match the supplied profile. A pleasing glow is not a compatibility test.

lines.caption: Single mode and multiple modes describe light propagation. They do not promise one or several independent payload channels.
lines.transcript: Single mode and multiple modes describe light propagation. They do not promise one or several independent payload channels.

lines.caption: I can illuminate the connection. Delivering electrical power through that fiber is outside my job description.
lines.transcript: I can illuminate the connection. Delivering electrical power through that fiber is outside my job description.

lines.caption: After a change, inspect and measure again. The old reading can stay in the notebook as history.
lines.transcript: After a change, inspect and measure again. The old reading can stay in the notebook as history.

lines.caption: Try the known pattern again over the repaired route. Compare what arrived with what was sent.
lines.transcript: Try the known pattern again over the repaired route. Compare what arrived with what was sent.

lines.caption: A steady light, a fresh check, and a record someone else can follow. That is a promising morning.
lines.transcript: A steady light, a fresh check, and a record someone else can follow. That is a promising morning.

lines.caption: Borrowed dawn is still dawn. Let us keep the temporary part written where nobody can miss it.
lines.transcript: Barrowed Dawn is still Dawn. Let us keep the temporary part written where nobody can miss it.

lines.caption: The light can wait. We know what is unresolved, and we have a safe place to begin again.
lines.transcript: The light can wait. We know what is unresolved and we have a safe place to begin again.

lines.caption: Welcome to the Shell Market. Please compare the specifications before admiring the polish.
lines.transcript: Welcome to the Shell Market. Please compare the specifications before admiring the polish.

lines.caption: A shell that fits the cage is only a start. Check the supported physical profile, medium and required wavelength.
lines.transcript: A shell that fits the cage is only a start. Check the supported physical profile, medium and required wavelength.

lines.caption: S F P names a form factor here. The particular module tells you what it actually supports.
lines.transcript: SFP names a form factor here. The particular module tells you what it actually supports.

lines.caption: The Chimera has a broader shell. Its lanes and breakout support still depend on the specified module profile.
lines.transcript: The Chimera has a broader shell. Its lanes and breakout support still depend on the specified module profile.

lines.caption: Keep delivered power separate from source power. This exercise supplies a budget at the endpoints.
lines.transcript: Keep delivered power separate from source power. This exercise supplies a budget at the endpoints.

lines.caption: Twelve, eleven and ten watts total thirty-three. This supplied thirty-watt budget is three watts short.
lines.transcript: 12, 11, and 10 watts total 33. This supplied 30-watt budget is 3-watt short.

lines.caption: Powered, yes. Communicating, not yet established. I have met many very well-lit broken links.
lines.transcript: Powered yes, communicating not yet established, I have met many very well-lit broken links.

lines.caption: An adequate optical budget cannot rescue an incompatible optic and fiber pair. Check both.
lines.transcript: An adequate optical budget cannot rescue an incompatible optic and fiber pair. Check both.

lines.caption: D B M is a power level. D B expresses a difference or ratio. Keep their labels attached to the numbers.
lines.transcript: DBM is a power level. DB expresses a difference or ratio. Keep their labels attached to the numbers.

lines.caption: Above sensitivity is not the whole test. Leave the stated reserve margin, and do not exceed the stated maximum receive level.
lines.transcript: Above sensitivity is not the whole test. Leave the stated reserve margin and do not exceed the stated maximum receive level.

lines.caption: Select the compatible parts for your chosen route. You need a repair kit, not the entire market.
lines.transcript: Select the compatible parts for your chosen route. You need a repair kit, not the entire market.

lines.caption: The ledger is less glamorous than a lightning bolt. It is also rather better at adding watts.
